item.title: Former school! Over 8,000 square feet! On two acres in Indiana. $829,000
item.description: This is the former Breaks School. This is a huge space with over 8,000 square feet! It was built in 1906. It is located on two acres in Crawfordsville, Indiana. The home features wood floors, tall ceilings, great staircases, built-in bookshelves, wine cellar, unique ceilings, bead board wainscoting, crown moulding, vintage light fixtures and nice architectural details. There is a detached barn on the property. Four bedrooms, five bathrooms and 8,478 square feet. $829,000 Contact Kelly Page with

item.title: Cool exterior and property! Circa 1871 in Kansas. $375,000
item.description: This house has such a cool exterior and property! The interior on the other hand is a bit of a let down. Wish we could see pictures of it before someone got hold of it. Most likely the flooring on the stairs continued throughout the house. The home was built in 1871. It is located on .26 acre in Winfield, Kansas. The home features a limestone exterior, pretty exterior details and original wood flooring on the stairs. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,037 square feet. $375,000 From the Zillow

item.title: That staircase! Circa 1910. Almost an acre in Kentucky. $589,900
item.description: This house has a pretty staircase! Love the porte cochere. They have a build date of 1920. Seems a tad older to me, like 1905-1910. It is located on .9 acre in Winchester, Kentucky. The house features a porte cochere, a covered porch, pocket doors, grand staircase, baseboards, beautiful chandelier, updated bathrooms, crown moulding and an updated kitchen. This house needs a floor plan. Curious about the kitchen staircase. Four bedrooms, five bathrooms and 4,374 square feet. $589,900 Contact Holl

item.title: Island time in Louisiana! First time this has been offered! $895,000
item.description: Island time in Louisiana! This is the first time this house and island has been offered. There is a designated parking spot at the marina for the new owner of the island. The house was built in 1925. It is located on 2.5 acres in Shreveport, Louisiana. The house is pretty! It features a large deck, stone chimney, wood floors, vaulted ceiling, exposed beams, stone chimney and log walls. There is a large dock with boat slip. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,100 square feet. $895,000 Contact Mic

item.title: Look at the porch details! Circa 1900 in Louisiana. $130,000
item.description: How about that porch trim! Beautiful! This house has nice details inside and out! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .27 acre in Winnfield, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, white picket fence, wood floors, baseboards, double sided fireplace, stained glass light fixtures, picture rails and crown moulding. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,957 square feet. $130,000 Contact Tammy Gunter with Gold Key Realty: 318-805-6124 From the Zillow listing: Victorian Home locat

item.title: Quaint! “Seaward Cottage”, Circa late 1800’s. Almost ten acres in Maine. $419,000
item.description: This house is so quaint! It looks like a pretty area! “Seaward Cottage” was built in the late 1800’s. It is located on 9.81 acres in Martinsville, Maine on the St. George Peninsula. The house features vaulted ceiling, beautiful wood floors, wainscoting, knotty pine, french doors and crown moulding. There is an outdoor shower and an outdoor fireplace. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,983 square feet. $419,000 Contact City + Harbor Real Estate From the Zillow listing: If you know the St. George

item.title: Private beach! The Eaton Cottage! Five acres in Maine. $459,000
item.description: There is a private beach on this property! The cottage has a lot o stained glass. This is known as the Eaton Cottage. It was built in 1889. It is located on 5.1 acres in Robbinston, Maine. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, stained glass windows, Rumford fireplace and exposed beams. There is a detached garage and a private 225′ beach. There is also a gated driveway. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,303 square feet. $459,000 Contact The Christopher Group From the Zillo

item.title: Original details inside! Over an acre in North Carolina. $399,000
item.description: This house has a lot of original features inside! Would be a fun house to work on! The house was built in 1901. It is located on 1.6 acres in Valdese, North Carolina. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, vintage light fixtures, seven fireplaces, wide baseboards, beautiful front door with stained glass, french doors, claw foot tub, crown moulding and bead board. There is an attached carport. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,729 square feet. $399,000 Contact John Henderso

item.title: Vintage Rose Antique Store! Circa 1700’s. Almost an acre in Virginia. $265,000
item.description: Wonder if the contents are included? Those are some early fireplaces in this house! Known as the Vintage Rose Antique Store. It is zoned residential, but can be grandfathered in as a antique store. The house was built sometime in the 1700’s. It is located on .83 acre in Altavista, Virginia. The house features double front porches, wide plank wood floors, great fireplaces and some exposed log walls. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,808 square feet. $265,000 Contact Cheryl Roberts Walton with Ne

item.title: Pretty setting! Over seven acres in Maryland. $299,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Looks livable. Would be a nice house to move into and work room by room. The house was built in 1920. It is located on 7.21 acres in Westminster, Maryland. The house features a covered front porch, some wood floors and baseboards. I like the light fixture in one of the bedrooms. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 814 square feet. $299,000 Contact Galen Roop with Cummings and Company Realtors: 410-259-1946 From the Zillow listing: Little green house on the prairie! Ad
